messages:
Alyssa: Heads-up — us-west GPU nodepool just hit 0 allocatable GPUs, lots of pending pods. Kube events show CA repeatedly trying to scale but nodes never become Ready. tagging @oncall :rotating_light:
Mike: Seeing the same. Pending pods are 'gpu-batch-*' from the nightly jobs. They requested 8g each, several launched at once.
Jia: Any recent config changes to autoscaler or nodepool quotas?
Alyssa: Not that I know. No deploys flagged. I ran `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep gpu` and nodes are provisioning but stuck in Provisioning state per cloud console.
Sam: I'm tailing events:
```
kubectl get events --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' -n kube-system
Normal 100s   ClusterAutoscaler ScaleUpError failed to create node: quotaExceeded
Warning 30s    NodeController Node creation failed: insufficient capacity
```
Jia: quotaExceeded — could be region GPU quota hit. I opened cloud quota page, looks like us-west GPUs at 0 remaining. Possibly other teams spun up reserved workloads.
autoscaler-bot: Incident created: GPU-PROV-1754012345. Severity: P2. Autoreporting metrics attached.
Mike: Immediate mitigation idea: taint the pool so new scheduled pods don't pile on provision attempts, then scale down excessively large batch job via k8s eviction or suspend job controller.
Alyssa: Agreed. Proposed steps: 1) identify runaway job(s) 2) cordon/taint nodepool to stop further scheduling 3) suspend job controller or scale replicas 4) request temporary quota bump or move some jobs to other regions.
Sam: Found the runaway — `gpu-batch-train-2026` CronJob kicked off 40 parallel pods at 03:00 due to misconfigured parallelism. It should have been 4.
Jia: Oof. Who owns that job?
Alyssa: Owner tag `ml-training` — @Jia can you coordinate with ML team to pause?
Jia: On it. Sending message to #eng-ml now.
Alyssa: I'm going to cordon the pool nodes and add taint `gpu-overflow=true:NoSchedule` to stop new pods while we triage.
Mike: Be careful — cordoning will prevent any scheduled pods from landing, but existing running pods stay. Good call to taint.
Sam: Command I ran to cordon just the gpu nodes:
```
kubectl get nodeselector -l pool=gpu-uswest -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl cordon
kubectl taint nodes -l pool=gpu-uswest gpu-overflow=true:NoSchedule
```
infra-bot: Applied taint to 12 nodes in pool gpu-uswest.
Alyssa: Taint applied. New pods are staying Pending, CA stopped aggressive scale ups.
Jia: ML team acknowledged — suspending the CronJob and scaling down active run from 40 -> 2.
Mike: Nice. Also removing pending scaledown/scaleup loops in CA by bumping `--scale-down-unneeded-time` temporarily? Should reduce churn.
Sam: I've increased CA cooldown to 10m via configmap patch: `kubectl -n kube-system patch configmap cluster-autoscaler --patch '...` (applied).
Alyssa: After suspending and tainting, cluster stabilized. Some pods remain Pending because they require 8g GPUs; we have ~6 running GPUs left across other regions.
Jia: I've opened a cloud quota request for +50 GPUs in us-west and cross-posted to infra channel for immediate approval.
Mike: For short-term, can we re-schedule low-priority batch jobs to us-east? We have spare capacity there. Suggest adding a nodeSelector/affinity override or a preemption policy.
Alyssa: I'll push a quick label change on the Deployments: add `region-preference: us-east` and create a kill-and-recreate script to move them.
Sam: Also recommend adding a smaller per-job parallelism guard in ML CI templates so one typo can't spawn 40 GPUs.
Jia: ML team agreed to add a safeguard and a quota annotation on CronJobs.
infra-bot: Quota request created: request-7892. Current state: pending approval. Link: https://console.cloud/quotas/request-7892
Alyssa: Follow-up actions (we'll file postmortem): 1) add limits on CronJob parallelism for gpu workloads 2) alerting on rapid spike in gpu-allocated pods 3) autoscaler config change review 4) region-aware spillover policy 5) add runbook for taint+cordon.
Mike: Rolling those into a short postmortem ticket. Also let's add an emergency circuit breaker annotation to critical CronJobs.
Jia: ML team will run a backfill in us-east for the missed runs.
Alyssa: Incident marked resolved for now — nodepool healthy after scaledown and quota request submitted. Will keep monitoring until quota bump or redistribution completed. :white_check_mark:
autoscaler-bot: Incident GPU-PROV-1754012345 status changed to RESOLVED by Alyssa at 1754013100.
Mike: Thanks everyone. Quick retro tomorrow in incidents channel at 10:00.
Sam: Uploading relevant logs and CA metrics to the incident ticket now.
